Table 2.41: TDEventBswInternalBehavior [constr_6858] Existence of TDEventBswInternalBehavior.tdEventBswIn- ternalBehaviorType Imposition time: IT_BswTd ⌈For each TDEventBswInternalBehavior, the attribute tdEventBswInternal- BehaviorType shall exist⌋ [constr_6859] Existence of TDEventBswInternalBehavior.bswModuleEntity Imposition time: IT_BswTd ⌈For each TDEventBswInternalBehavior, the reference to BswModuleEntity in the role bswModuleEntity shall exist⌋ Please note: For every TDEventBswInternalBehavior its scope is defined by the bswModuleEntity reference. It points to the BSW module entity for which the event can be observed. This scope definition assumes that every BSW module exists only once on each ECU. Otherwise the scope would not be precise enough because every module instance would bring the same BSW module entities.
